newsitem.title: USA: TRAVELERS TO BUY BACK $240.8 MLN IN SHARES.
newsitem.headline: TRAVELERS TO BUY BACK $240.8 MLN IN SHARES.

text.p: Travelers Property Casualty Corp said Monday it has agreed to buy back about 6.6 million shares its class A common stock from private investors for a total of about $240.8 million.
The company said the stock is held by Aetna Services Inc, J.P. Morgan Capital Corp, Fund American Enterprises Holdings and Trident Partnership LP.
The company said the purchases represent 20 percent of the holdings of each of the private investors.
As part of the buyback agreement, the lockup period for 50 percent of the remaining shares held by the private investors will be extended by six months to March 15, 1998.
Travelers Property said the deal satisfies its previously announced intention to buy back $100 million of its shares.

The company had repurchased about 1.17 million shares the program, which is now ended. It said repurchased shares would be used for issuing of stock for various compensation plans and for other corporate purposes.
After the purchases, Travelers Group Inc's stake in Travelers Property Casualty will rise to 83.4 percent.
